title: Tunisian Garlic Chicken Shawarma
description: A flavorful and aromatic dish inspired by the streets of Tunisia, featuring garlicy chicken, crispy onions, and a hint of nostalgia.
instructions: 1. In a large bowl, whisk together Tunisian spice blend, lemon juice, and 2 cloves of minced garlic.
2. Add the chicken to the marinade and toss to coat. Cover and refrigerate for at least 30 minutes.
3. Preheat a grill or grill pan to medium-high heat.
4. Remove the chicken from the marinade and cook for 5-7 minutes per side, or until cooked through.
5. Meanwhile, brush the sliced onions with olive oil and cook in a skillet over medium heat until crispy.
6. Warm the pita breads by wrapping them in foil and heating them in the oven for 5 minutes.
7. Assemble the shawarma by placing a few slices of chicken onto each pita bread, followed by some crispy onions and a sprinkle of parsley.
